# Sources

Store working notes and annotations organized around a specific book, PDF, class, course, paper, website, or other source here. Source-bound notes preserve what that source claims; synthesis that represents finalized, reviewed understanding belongs under `knowledge/`.

Create source notes from the matching template—`templates/book.md`, `course.md`, `paper.md`, `web.md`, or the `other.md` fallback—under `books/`, `courses/`, `papers/`, or `web/`.

Repository-managed source files belong under `assets/`; source files intentionally kept elsewhere remain externally located according to the accepted storage policy. The fixture does not contain private source material.
